### What is EarnKaro?

EarnKaro is a Deal-Sharing Platform that helps you make easy money! Whether you are an Affiliate Marketer, a student, a housewife or a working professional, EarnKaro is a great source of extra income for you.

### How do I use EarnKaro?

All you have to do is simply share deals from brands like Flipkart, Myntra, Axis Bank & more. When your friends, family & others from your network shop through your Profit Link, you Earn Profit!

### Why is EarnKaro the best indian affiliate platform?

EarnKaro offers an array of affiliate programs that you can join for free without any documentation. You can easily earn ₹20,000 to ₹30,000 per month by sharing deals & getting orders via EarnKaro.

### How easy is this experience?

The reselling experience is super easy. You can start a reselling business online for free. Whether you are a housewife, student, working professional, or retired person, you can resell from top online brands to anyone at any time! All you need to simply do is make them shop via your EarnKaro Profit Links.

### Is EarnKaro 100% Free?

Joining Affiliate Programs via EarnKaro is absolutely FREE. All you need is a smartphone & an eye for catchy deals! You can copy & convert deals of Flipkart, Myntra, Axis Bank & 200+ brands.

### How do I transfer money to my bank?

EarnKaro has the lowest withdrawal threshold of ₹10, across the industry! As soon as you earn ₹10 or above Confirmed Profit, you can simply transfer your Profit into your Bank Account as #AsliCash.

### How can I become an affiliate of 200+ Brands?

We offer a common platform for all your reselling needs! Becoming a Flipkart Affiliate or a Myntra Affiliate can be a bit of a task. But with EarnKaro, you can become an affiliate marketer of any brand we have. Now, no more hassles!

### How is the customer support experience?

At EarnKaro, users are given the highest priority. If you have any queries, contact our Customer Support team. You can email us, call us, WhatsApp us, or reach out to us on any of our social media channels.

### Who can make money from home using EarnKaro?

EarnKaro is an easy money-making platform, on which you can become an affiliate marketer for any brand listed with us. People who want to work part-time or full-time to earn a bit extra. All you need is a good network of people to share your Profit links with and earn money on every order!

### How do we help homemakers earn from home?

EarnKaro is the best way to earn money for homemakers. If you are a homemaker, then you can use EarnKaro to earn from your network in & around your society, among your friend circle, & family. EarnKaro is empowering the women of India to become an earning member of the household.

### How do students earn money on the go?

Worried about pocket money? Thousands of students use EarnKaro to become independent. Since all your friends are shopping online, share your Profit links on WhatsApp, Telegram, or any social media platform, get orders & earn.
